# @liaugust/monobank-sdk

> Unofficial, strict, runtime-validated TypeScript SDK for the Monobank API,
> spanning the Public, Personal, Acquiring, and Corporate credential families.
> It implements 49 of the 63 documented operations, not the whole API. Supports
> Node.js 22.12.0+, ESM, CommonJS, and modern browser bundlers. Zod Mini
> validates every successful JSON response.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@liaugust/monobank-sdk
Repository: https://github.com/liaugust/monobank-typescript-sdk
API reference: https://github.com/liaugust/monobank-typescript-sdk/blob/main/docs/API.md
Upstream docs: https://monobank.ua/api-docs and https://api.monobank.ua/docs/
Uncovered endpoints: https://github.com/liaugust/monobank-typescript-sdk/issues/59
License: MIT

## Use the package

Install with `pnpm add @liaugust/monobank-sdk` or
`npm install @liaugust/monobank-sdk`.

Import only from `@liaugust/monobank-sdk`. Choose the client by credential
family; do not use the authenticated clients for public calls.

```ts
import {
  MonobankPersonalClient,
  MonobankPublicClient,
} from "@liaugust/monobank-sdk";

const publicApi = new MonobankPublicClient();
const personal = new MonobankPersonalClient({
  token: validatedConfig.monobankToken,
});
```

Use `MonobankAcquiringClient` with a separate Acquiring token.

Use `MonobankCorporateClient` for the Corporate provider API. It takes no
token: pass the service `keyId` and a `sign` function. `keyId` is optional
only for the registration flow, which is what issues it. Keys are secp256k1,
which Web Crypto cannot sign with, so the private key stays in the application
and the SDK only calls the signer.

```ts
import { MonobankCorporateClient } from "@liaugust/monobank-sdk";

const corporate = new MonobankCorporateClient({
  keyId: validatedConfig.monobankCorporateKeyId,
  sign: ({ payload }) => signSecp256k1Raw(payload),
});
```

The signer returns the `X-Sign` value: base64 of the raw 64-byte `r || s`
pair, not DER. Monobank documents neither the digest nor whether `URL` in
`Sign (X-Time | URL)` includes the query, so the signer also receives `time`,
`requestId`, and `url` and can rebuild the payload. This SDK signs the path
with its query. The signer runs once per attempt, because `X-Time` is signed
and a retry must not replay a stale timestamp. `timeoutMs` bounds the signer as well as the request: a signer that never settles
fails with reason `timeout`.

## Client methods

- `publicApi.bank.getSync(options?)`: public `/bank/sync`; no `X-Token`; returns
  `Promise<BankSync>`.
- `publicApi.currency.getRates(options?)`: public `/bank/currency`; no `X-Token`;
  returns `Promise<readonly CurrencyRate[]>`.
- `personal.client.getInfo(options?)`: authenticated `/personal/client-info`;
  returns `Promise<ClientInfo>`; upstream limit is one call per 60 seconds.
- `personal.statements.get(input, options?)`: authenticated statements; returns
  `Promise<readonly StatementItem[]>`; maximum inclusive window is 2,682,000
  seconds; `Date` inputs become Unix seconds.
- `personal.webhooks.set(input, options?)`: authenticated webhook mutation;
  accepts an absolute HTTP(S) URL or `""` to remove it; never retried
  automatically.
- `parsePersonalWebhookEvent(input)`: validates webhook JSON shape; does not
  authenticate the sender.
- `corporate.access.request(input?, options?)`: signed
  `POST /personal/auth/request`; optional `input.callbackUrl` becomes
  `X-Callback`; returns `Promise<CorporateTokenRequest>` with `tokenRequestId`
  and `acceptUrl` to show the client; never retried.
- `corporate.access.check(input, options?)`: signed
  `GET /personal/auth/request` with `X-Request-Id` in the signed payload;
  resolves `Promise<void>` when granted; 401 means still pending and 404 means
  unknown request; safe GET and re-signed on each retry.
- `corporate.clients.getInfo(input, options?)`: signed
  `GET /personal/client-info` for a granted client; requires
  `input.requestId`; returns `Promise<ClientInfo>`; safe GET; upstream limit is
  one call per 60 seconds.
- `corporate.clients.getStatements(input, options?)`: signed delegated
  statements; requires `input.requestId` and `input.from`; `input.account`
  defaults to `0`; maximum window 2,682,000 seconds; returns
  `Promise<readonly StatementItem[]>`; safe GET.
- `corporate.documents.requestSigning(input, options?)`: signed monoКЕП
  request for 1-10 documents; each needs `name` and a ГОСТ 34.311-95 hex `hash`
  the caller computes, since no JS runtime implements that algorithm; returns
  `Promise<DocumentSigningRequest>` with `requestId` and `deeplink`; valid three
  days; never retried.
- `corporate.documents.getSigningStatus(input, options?)`: signed status read;
  returns `Promise<DocumentSigningStatus>` with per-document state and
  signatories; safe GET.
- `corporate.documents.cancelSigning(input, options?)`: signed HTTP DELETE
  cancelling a signing request; resolves `Promise<void>`; never retried.
- `corporate.company.register(input, options?)`: signed pre-key
  `/personal/auth/registration` application; no `X-Key-Id`; returns
  `Promise<CorporateRegistration>`; never retried.
- `corporate.company.getRegistrationStatus(input, options?)`: signed pre-key
  status poll; returns `Promise<CorporateRegistrationStatusResult>` with the
  issued `keyId` once `Approved`; never retried.
- `corporate.company.getSettings(input, options?)`: signed
  `/personal/corp/settings`; requires `input.requestId`; returns
  `Promise<CorporateSettings>`; safe GET and re-signed on each retry.
- `corporate.company.setWebhook(input, options?)`: signed
  `/personal/corp/webhook` mutation; Monobank test-POSTs the URL during the
  call; empty string removes it; never retried.
- `acquiring.merchant.getDetails(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/details`; returns `Promise<MerchantDetails>`.
- `acquiring.statements.get(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/statement`; accepts required `from`, optional `to`, and
  optional submerchant terminal `code`; returns `Promise<AcquiringStatement>`
  whose readonly `list` is ordered newest first.
- `acquiring.submerchants.list(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/submerchant/list`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringSubmerchantList>` with a readonly list of terminal codes,
  IBANs, and optional owner details.
- `acquiring.qr.list(options?)`: authenticated `/api/merchant/qr/list`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringQrCashierList>` with a readonly list of `shortQrId`,
  `qrId`, `amountType`, and `pageUrl`; safe GET eligible for configured
  retries.
- `acquiring.qr.getDetails(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/qr/details`; requires a nonempty string `qrId` without
  surrounding whitespace and rejects with `MonobankValidationError` before
  Fetch otherwise; returns `Promise<AcquiringQrDetails>` for activated QR
  cashiers only, so a cashier returned by `acquiring.qr.list()` can still fail
  with status 404; pass `qrId`, not `shortQrId`. `invoiceId` is documented as
  present only while an amount is set and `amount`/`ccy` may be omitted for the
  same reason, so a successful response may carry `shortQrId` alone; safe GET
  eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.employees.list(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/employee/list`; returns `Promise<AcquiringEmployeeList>` with
  employees eligible for tips; safe GET eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.wallet.list(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/wallet`; requires `walletId`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringWallet>` with a readonly list of tokenized cards; safe GET.
- `acquiring.wallet.pay(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/wallet/payment`; charges a stored `cardToken`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringCardPayment>` carrying `tdsUrl` when 3-D Secure is
  required; mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.wallet.deleteCard(input, options?)`: authenticated HTTP DELETE to
  `/api/merchant/wallet/card`; returns `Promise<void>`; mutating, never
  retried.
- `acquiring.invoices.payDirect(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/invoice/payment-direct`; accepts raw `cardData` with `pan`,
  `exp`, and `cvv`, which places the caller in PCI DSS scope; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringCardPayment>`; mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.invoices.syncPayment(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/invoice/sync-payment`; requires exactly one of `cardData`,
  `applePay`, or `googlePay`, all of which are PCI DSS material; returns
  `Promise<Invoice>`; mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.qr.resetAmount(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/qr/reset-amount`; POSTs `{ qrId }` to clear the amount set on
  a QR cashier; returns `Promise<void>` because Monobank acknowledges with an
  empty payload; mutating, so it is never retried automatically.
- `acquiring.subscriptions.create(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/subscription/create`; takes `amount`, `interval` as
  `{count}{d|w|m|y}`, and optional `ccy`, `redirectUrl`, `validity`, and
  `webHookUrls.{chargeUrl,statusUrl}`; returns
  `Promise<NewAcquiringSubscription>` carrying `subscriptionId` and the
  `pageUrl` where the payer authorizes the first payment; mutating, never
  retried. `validity` above 30 days is silently truncated upstream.
- `acquiring.subscriptions.getStatus(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/subscription/status`; returns `Promise<AcquiringSubscription>`;
  Monobank documents a sample rather than a schema, so only `subscriptionId` and
  `status` are guaranteed, and `walletData.cardToken` is credential material;
  safe GET eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.subscriptions.list(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/subscription/list`; requires `dateFrom` and takes optional
  `dateTo`, `limit`, `page`, and a `status` filter of `active` or `cancelled`;
  windows are RFC-3339 rather than the Unix seconds statements use; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringSubscriptionList>`; safe GET eligible for configured
  retries.
- `acquiring.subscriptions.getPayments(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/subscription/payments`; requires `subscriptionId` and
  `dateFrom`; returns `Promise<AcquiringSubscriptionPaymentList>`; safe GET
  eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.subscriptions.edit(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/subscription/edit`; POSTs `{ action, subscriptionId }` with
  `action` limited to `AcquiringSubscriptionAction.Cancel`, plus an optional
  `refundAmount` that refunds as part of the same cancellation; returns
  `Promise<void>`; mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.subscriptions.remove(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/subscription/remove`; POSTs `{ subscriptionId }` to deactivate
  without refunding; returns `Promise<void>`; mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.monopay.listKeys(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/monopay/pubkey-list`; returns `Promise<MonopaySigningKeyList>`
  whose entries arrive under `result` rather than `list`; safe GET eligible for
  configured retries.
- `acquiring.monopay.importKey(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/monopay/pubkey-import`; POSTs the Base64 **public** half as
  `keyValue` with optional `keyName` and `expiresAt`; returns
  `Promise<ImportedMonopaySigningKey>` whose `result.keyId` names the key;
  mutating, never retried. The private half must never enter the SDK.
- `acquiring.monopay.deleteKey(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/monopay/pubkey-delete`; POSTs `{ keyId }`; returns
  `Promise<void>`; invalidates every widget signature made with that key;
  mutating, never retried.
- `acquiring.t2p.listTerminals(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/t2p/terminal/list`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringT2pTerminalList>`; safe GET eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.t2p.getPaymentStatus(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/t2p/terminal/payment/external/status`; takes
  `externalPaymentId`; returns `Promise<AcquiringT2pPayment>`; Monobank keeps
  these payments 90 days and answers 404 afterwards; safe GET eligible for
  configured retries.
- `acquiring.split.listReceivers(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/split-receiver/list`; returns
  `Promise<AcquiringSplitReceiverList>` whose `splitReceiverId` values feed
  `merchantPaymInfo.basketOrder[].splitReceiverId`; each entry's `edrpou`
  identifies a real business; safe GET eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.pos.cancelTransaction(input, options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/pos-transaction-cancel`; POSTs `{ rrn, amount }` to refund a POS
  transaction; returns `Promise<AcquiringPosCancellation>` acknowledging the
  refund was initiated rather than settled; moves money, never retried.
- `acquiring.webhooks.getPublicKey(options?)`: authenticated
  `/api/merchant/pubkey`; returns `Promise<AcquiringWebhookPublicKey>`; caller
  owns caching and refresh after signature verification fails.
- `verifyAcquiringWebhookSignature(input)`: authenticates exact raw body bytes
  against the `X-Sign` ASN.1 DER signature using built-in Web Crypto; returns
  `Promise<boolean>` and requires no additional runtime dependency.
- `acquiring.invoices.create(input, options?)`: creates a hosted Acquiring
  invoice; returns `Promise<NewInvoice>`; never retried automatically.
  `redirectUrl` covers both outcomes, while `successUrl` and `failUrl` split
  them and are disabled by default until Monobank support enables them.
  `displayType: "iframe"` returns a widget link; `withAppUrl: true` adds
  `appUrl`, a `monobank://` deeplink, to the result and is unsupported for QR
  and verification payments. `paymentType: "verification"` requires `amount: 0`
  and `saveCardData.saveCard: true` and is rejected locally without them.
  `merchantPaymInfo.metadata` and `merchantPaymInfo.basketOrder[].splitReceiverId`
  are forwarded as given.
- `acquiring.invoices.getStatus(input, options?)`: returns `Promise<Invoice>`
  for an `invoiceId`; safe GET eligible for configured retries.
- `acquiring.invoices.cancel(input, options?)`: full or partial payment
  cancellation; returns `Promise<InvoiceCancellation>`; never retried
  automatically.
- `acquiring.invoices.remove(input, options?)`: invalidates an unpaid invoice;
  returns `Promise<void>`; never retried automatically.
- `acquiring.invoices.finalize(input, options?)`: captures a held amount;
  returns `Promise<InvoiceFinalization>`; never retried automatically.
- `acquiring.invoices.getReceipt(input, options?)`: gets a base64 receipt and
  can request email delivery; returns `Promise<InvoiceReceipt>`.
- `acquiring.invoices.getFiscalChecks(input, options?)`: returns
  `Promise<InvoiceFiscalChecks>`.

Each optional request `options` object accepts `signal?: AbortSignal`.

## Constructor options

- `token: string`: required only for Personal and Acquiring clients; Personal
  credentials are sent only to `/personal/*`, and Acquiring credentials only
  to `/api/merchant/*`.
- `fetch?: FetchLike`: injected Fetch-compatible implementation.
- `baseUrl?: string`: absolute HTTP(S) origin for controlled proxies or tests, https-only when a token is configured unless the host is loopback.
- `timeoutMs?: number`: per-attempt timeout in milliseconds.
- `retry?: { baseDelayMs; maxAttempts; maxDelayMs }`: bounded retry policy for
  safe GET requests. Retries are disabled when omitted.

## Errors

- `MonobankValidationError`: invalid configuration or method input before
  Fetch.
- `MonobankNetworkError`: Fetch failure with reason `network`, `timeout`, or
  `aborted`.
- `MonobankApiError`: non-2xx response; includes status and optional
  `retryAfterMs` and safe upstream message.
- `MonobankResponseValidationError`: successful payload failed runtime schema
  validation.

Errors intentionally do not retain tokens, authorization headers, Request
objects, or raw API payloads.

## Exported runtime values

- Enum-like const objects: `AccountType`, `CashbackType`,
  `AcquiringPaymentScheme`, `AcquiringQrAmountType`,
  `AcquiringStatementStatus`, `InvoicePaymentType`,
  `InvoiceStatus`, `InvoiceCancellationStatus`, `InvoicePaymentSystem`,
  `InvoicePaymentMethod`, `InvoiceWalletStatus`, `DiscountType`, `DiscountMode`,
  `FiscalCheckType`, `FiscalCheckStatus`, `FiscalizationSource`,
  `CorporateRegistrationStatus`, `DocumentSigningState`, `SigningDocumentType`.
- Schemas: `accountSchema`, `bankSyncSchema`, `clientInfoSchema`,
  `corporateRegistrationSchema`, `corporateRegistrationStatusSchema`,
  `corporateSettingsSchema`, `corporateTokenRequestSchema`,
  `documentSignatorySchema`, `documentSigningRequestSchema`,
  `documentSigningStatusSchema`, `signingDocumentSchema`,
  `currencyRateSchema`, `currencyRatesSchema`, `jarSchema`,
  `managedAccountSchema`, `managedClientSchema`, `statementItemSchema`,
  `statementItemsSchema`, `personalWebhookEventSchema`,
  `merchantDetailsSchema`, `acquiringStatementSchema`,
  `acquiringStatementItemSchema`, `acquiringStatementCancellationSchema`,
  `acquiringSubmerchantSchema`, `acquiringSubmerchantListSchema`,
  `acquiringQrCashierSchema`, `acquiringQrCashierListSchema`,
  `acquiringQrDetailsSchema`, `acquiringWebhookPublicKeySchema`,
  `newInvoiceSchema`, `invoiceStatusSchema`,
  `cancelInvoiceResponseSchema`, `finalizeInvoiceResponseSchema`,
  `receiptSchema`, `invoiceFiscalChecksSchema`.
- Errors: `MonobankApiError`, `MonobankNetworkError`,
  `MonobankResponseValidationError`, `MonobankValidationError`.
- Clients/helpers: `MonobankPublicClient`, `MonobankPersonalClient`,
  `MonobankAcquiringClient`, `parsePersonalWebhookEvent`,
  `verifyAcquiringWebhookSignature`. Resource classes are available through
  parent properties and are not root runtime exports.

See `src/index.ts` for the complete authoritative export list, including types.

## Data rules

- Monetary integers use the currency's minor units.
- Currency codes are numeric ISO 4217 codes.
- Rate and Personal statement timestamps are Unix seconds; Acquiring statement
  request inputs use Unix seconds while response `date` fields use RFC-3339.
- Acquiring subscription windows are RFC-3339 in both directions; a `Date` is
  accepted and serialized with `toISOString()`.
- Tap-to-phone payments break these conventions and are preserved as documented:
  `ccy` is alphabetic such as `UAH`, `dataTime` is space-separated rather than
  RFC-3339, `errorMessage` is explicitly `null` on success, and `maskedPan` holds
  the card number while `cardMask` holds the scheme.
- `BankSync.serverTimeMsec` is Unix milliseconds.
- Response schemas preserve unknown additive fields.
- Upstream field spelling is preserved, including `webHookUrl` on invoices and
  the unrelated plural `webHookUrls` on subscriptions.

## Safety rules for generated code

- Never expose, log, or commit a real token or banking payload.
- Never mix Personal and Acquiring tokens or send `X-Token` to public
  `/bank/*` endpoints.
- The transport sets `redirect: "error"`, so a redirect surfaces as
  `MonobankNetworkError` and a token is never replayed to another origin. A
  custom `fetch` must honor `RequestInit.redirect` or that protection is lost.
- Never treat webhook parsing as sender authentication.
- For Acquiring webhooks, verify the exact raw body bytes before parsing or
  transforming them. Read `X-Sign`, use the key from
  `acquiring.webhooks.getPublicKey()`, and reject a `false` result.
- Never retry `personal.webhooks.set()`, `acquiring.invoices.create()`,
  `acquiring.invoices.cancel()`, `acquiring.invoices.remove()`,
  `acquiring.invoices.finalize()`, `acquiring.invoices.payDirect()`,
  `acquiring.invoices.syncPayment()`, `acquiring.wallet.pay()`,
  `acquiring.wallet.deleteCard()`, `acquiring.qr.resetAmount()`,
  `acquiring.subscriptions.create()`, `acquiring.subscriptions.edit()`,
  `acquiring.subscriptions.remove()`, `acquiring.monopay.importKey()`,
  `acquiring.monopay.deleteKey()`, or `acquiring.pos.cancelTransaction()`
  automatically.
- Never log, persist, or echo raw card details or Apple Pay and Google Pay
  crypto-container values. Prefer `acquiring.invoices.create()` or
  `acquiring.wallet.pay()` over `acquiring.invoices.payDirect()`.
- Do not invent Acquiring APIs beyond the implemented merchant-details,
  submerchant-list, QR, subscription, monopay-key, tap-to-phone, split-receiver,
  POS-refund, statement, webhook-trust, and invoice-lifecycle
  methods.
- Prefer exported SDK types, schemas, value objects, and error classes over
  duplicate local definitions.
- Retries cover only safe GET requests, and never timeouts. The retryable status
  set defaults to `defaultRetryableStatusCodes` (`429, 500, 502, 503, 504`) and is
  narrowed with `retry.retryableStatusCodes`. Prefer `[500, 502, 503, 504]` for a
  Personal client, because `/personal/client-info` and `/personal/statement` allow
  one request per 60 seconds and a retried `429` only spends more quota.
- Never configure a cleartext `http:` `baseUrl` together with a token; the SDK
  rejects it at construction unless the host is loopback.
- Validate environment configuration before constructing the client.

- `README.md`: human-facing guide and examples.

  schemas, errors, and examples.
- `AGENTS.md`: operational rules for agents using or modifying the SDK.
